full_prompt_en: A square detailed landscape painting shows a wooded valley with several tiered waterfalls beneath a broad softly clouded sky. The sky occupies the upper quarter in pale blue and warm cream, its large clouds opening above distant low hills. At the far left, a heavy tree trunk rises from a rocky foreground bank and spreads a dark leafy canopy across the upper corner. Another tall tree stands on a sunlit rise at the upper right. Between these frames, green fields and small pale structures extend through the middle distance toward hazy hills. The nearer terrain is full of dark foliage, rocky ledges, and winding streams. A narrow fall drops among trees at the left middle; another white cascade descends from a right-side terrace. In the lower right, the main waterfall pours over a broad ocher rock shelf into a gray-green pool. Its pale vertical ribbons and foamy base are the brightest details in the foreground. The stream curves toward the lower center, passing small stones, low shrubs, and patches of damp dark earth. On the right hillside, thin paths or terraces weave between trees and rocks, giving the eye multiple routes into the picture. The painting uses many tiny marks for leaves, bark, stone, and distant field boundaries without losing the broad valley shape. Warm daylight enters from the upper left, catching the open fields and ocher cliffs while the framing trees remain in deep green shade. The overall composition is abundant and orderly, with dark near foliage enclosing a luminous distance and the stepped water carrying the eye through the scene.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形细节丰富的风景绘画呈现一座林木山谷，数层瀑布在宽阔柔云天空下跌落。天空占据上方四分之一，浅蓝与暖奶油色的大云在远方低丘上展开。最左边，一根厚树干从岩石前景岸边升起，深色树冠铺过上方角落。另一棵高树立在右上受光高地。两边框景之间，绿色田块与小型浅色建筑穿过中景，延向朦胧山丘。近处地形布满深色枝叶、岩台与曲折溪水。左侧中部一道窄瀑在树间落下；另一道白色水流从右侧台地垂落。右下的主瀑布越过宽阔赭色岩棚，注入灰绿水池。浅色竖向水带和下方白沫是前景最亮细节。溪流向下部中央弯去，经过小石块、低灌木和潮湿深土。右侧山坡上，细路或台地在树石之间穿行，为视线提供几条进入画面的路径。绘画以许多细小笔迹描述叶、树皮、石头和远方田界，却没有失去山谷的大形。暖日光从左上进入，照亮开阔田野与赭色崖壁，框景树木则保持深绿阴影。整体构图丰盛而有序，深色近处枝叶围住明亮远方，层叠水流带动视线穿过场景。
style_prompt_en: The detailed oil painting layers many small naturalistic marks within a clearly organized sequence of dark foreground, varied middle tones, and luminous distance. Deep olive and umber frame a softer range of sage green, ocher, gray-blue, and warm cream. Rounded canopies and irregular ledges overlap repeatedly, while thin pale vertical passages cut through them and lead the eye downward. Fine textures distinguish leafy, rocky, and fluid surfaces; none are reduced to uniform blur. Soft daylight brightens open planes and distant haze, leaving nearer framing masses darker for depth. The composition is dense but not flat, because paths of lighter value thread between substantial shadowed groups. Edges sharpen at selected foreground details and soften toward the horizon. The overall effect is pastoral, intricate, and expansive, with patient observation contained by a balanced light-dark structure.
style_prompt_zh: 细节丰富的油画在清楚组织的深色前景、多变中间调和明亮远景之内叠加许多细小自然主义笔迹。深橄榄绿与棕褐框住较柔和的鼠尾草绿、赭黄、灰蓝和暖奶油色。圆润树冠与不规则岩台反复遮叠，细浅色竖向段落从中切过并引导视线向下。细肌理区分叶状、岩质和流动表面，没有把它们统统模糊。柔和日光照亮开阔平面和远处雾气，近处框景团块保持更暗，以建立深度。构图密实却不平，因为较亮的明度路径穿行在厚重阴影组之间。边缘在少数前景细节处锐化，向地平线软化。整体效果田园、细密而开阔，耐心观察被平衡的明暗结构容纳。
theme_en: A wooded valley with tiered waterfalls beneath a cloudy sky
theme_zh: 云天下有层叠瀑布的林木山谷
name: Jan van Kessel the Elder
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
